CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_foreman()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id=(SELECT auth.uid())
      AND role='foreman'
      AND is_active=true
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_non_foreman_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v boolean;
begin
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles
    where id=(select auth.uid())
      and role in ('director','finance','accountant')
      and is_active=true
  ) into v;
  return v;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.foreman_projects()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, customer text, contract_number text, contract_date date, start_date date, end_date date, status text, responsible_user_id uuid, comment text, contractor_company text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p.id,p.name,p.customer,p.contract_number,p.contract_date,
         p.start_date,p.end_date,p.status,p.responsible_user_id,
         p.comment,p.contractor_company
  from public.projects p
  where exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles me
    where me.id=(select auth.uid())
      and me.role in ('foreman','manager')
      and me.is_active=true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.foreman_subcontractors()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, project_id uuid, name text, comment text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT s.id,s.project_id,s.name,s.comment,s.created_at
  FROM public.subcontractors s
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles me
    WHERE me.id=(SELECT auth.uid())
      AND me.role='foreman'
      AND me.is_active=true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_manager_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v boolean;
begin
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles
    where id=(select auth.uid())
      and role='manager'
      and is_active=true
  ) into v;
  return v;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalc_payable_paid_amount(p_payable_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if p_payable_id is null then return; end if;
 update public.payables p set paid_amount=coalesce((select sum(o.amount) from public.operations o where o.payable_id=p_payable_id and o.operation_type='expense' and o.article='Погашение кредиторки'),0),updated_at=now() where p.id=p_payable_id;
end $function$
